claims.citation: New York Herald, 11 June 1866, p. 8, col. 6

claims.claim: Brought news from St. Petersburg, to 1866-06-13
claims.citation: New York Herald, 8 July 1866, p. 2, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Wednesday the steamer Bride, belonging to Messrs.
Brown, Atkinson & Co., of Hull, arrived at that port
from St. Petersburg with a somewhat light cargo. The
Bride left St. Petersburg on the 13th inst., and at that
time freights were very low.
